name: Combat Superiority
description: Choose three maneuvers. Each costs one d8 Superiority Die; only one maneuver can modify an attack. You have four dice and recover them all after a Short or Long Rest. Maneuver save DC = 8 + Proficiency Bonus + your choice of Strength or Dexterity modifier.

name: Student of War
description: Choose one Artisan's Tools proficiency and one skill proficiency from the Fighter's starting skill list.

name: Ambush
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). Add d8 to Initiative or Dexterity (Stealth); unavailable while Incapacitated.

name: Bait and Switch
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). On your turn, spend 5 feet of movement to swap with a willing, non-Incapacitated creature within 5 feet; neither provokes Opportunity Attacks for this move. You or that creature gains +d8 AC until your next turn starts.

name: Commander's Strike
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). During your Attack action, replace one attack. A willing creature seeing or hearing you can use its Reaction for a weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, with +d8 damage on a hit. Your Bonus Action remains available.

name: Commanding Presence
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). Add d8 to a Charisma check using Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion.

name: Disarming Attack
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). After an attack roll hits, add d8 damage. A failed Strength save makes the target drop one held object you choose into its own space.

name: Distracting Strike
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). After an attack roll hits, add d8 damage. Another attacker's next attack against that target has Advantage if made before your next turn starts.

name: Evasive Footwork
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). Use a Bonus Action to Disengage and gain +d8 AC until your next turn starts.

name: Feinting Attack
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). Use a Bonus Action to select a creature within 5 feet. Your next attack against it this turn has Advantage and, if it hits, +d8 damage.

name: Goading Attack
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). After an attack roll hits, add d8 damage. On a failed Wisdom save, the target attacks others with Disadvantage until your next turn ends.

name: Lunging Attack
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). Use a Bonus Action to Dash. This turn, add d8 damage to a melee hit during your Attack action if you moved at least 5 feet straight immediately before that hit.

name: Maneuvering Attack
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). After an attack roll hits, add d8 damage. A willing creature seeing or hearing you can use its Reaction to move half its Speed; that movement avoids Opportunity Attacks from the target you hit.

name: Menacing Attack
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). After an attack roll hits, add d8 damage. On a failed Wisdom save, the target is Frightened until your next turn ends.

name: Parry
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). When another creature damages you with a melee attack roll, use your Reaction to reduce that damage by d8 + your choice of Strength or Dexterity modifier.

name: Precision Attack
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). After an attack roll misses, add d8 to that roll; the result may turn the miss into a hit.

name: Pushing Attack
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). After a weapon attack or Unarmed Strike hits, add d8 damage. A Large or smaller target failing a Strength save moves up to 15 feet directly away from you.

name: Rally
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). Use a Bonus Action to grant an ally within 30 feet d8 + half your Fighter level (rounded down) Temporary HP. The ally must see or hear you.

name: Riposte
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). When a melee attack roll misses you, use your Reaction for a melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against that attacker. A hit adds d8 damage.

name: Sweeping Attack
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). After a melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike hits, select another creature within your reach and 5 feet of the first target. If the original attack roll meets its AC, it takes d8 damage of the original type.

name: Tactical Assessment
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). Add d8 to Intelligence (History or Investigation) or Wisdom (Insight).

name: Trip Attack
description: Spend 1 Superiority Die (d8). After a weapon attack or Unarmed Strike hits, add d8 damage. A Large or smaller target failing a Strength save becomes Prone.
